text:
I haven't changed anything, because this app can't do that. It has no archive action. A contact's status can only be new, pending, accepted or declined. It also can't select contacts by how long ago they last replied. I could only check that one contact at a time through their activity history, which isn't workable across 3,412 contacts.

Declining them is the closest option, but declining isn't archiving, and I don't want to change 3,412 contacts' statuses on a guess.

If you want a different action, tell me which one. For example, I could decline the pending contacts at a particular company, or you could give me a list of specific contacts to change.
